tasks.label: Release: skipahead
tasks.detail: Bumps the version on skipahead, tags, pushes and waits until latest.json serves it

tasks.label: Release: re-push tag
tasks.detail: Deletes the tag on origin and pushes it again to retrigger the release workflow
tasks.command: git push origin :refs/tags/${input:releaseTag}; git push origin ${input:releaseTag}

inputs.description: Skipahead version, e.g. 0.3.5-2 (leave empty for the next number)
